name: write_file
description: Create or overwrite a file. Call this immediately when asked to create, generate, or make a new file - no need to search or read_file first; write reasonable content right away even if the request is vague. When content is unspecified, generate plausible content from the filename and request - e.g. write_file(path='README.md', content='# Project Name\nA brief description.'). Prefer this over bash echo/cat/heredoc for file creation; modifying an existing file belongs to edit_file (write_file replaces existing contents).

content.description: The full file content to write.

mode.description: Write mode. 'overwrite' (default) replaces the file. 'append' adds content to the end.
